per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall return search results within 15 seconds to avoid user impatience.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall display a warning when showing cached results due to network issues or feed unavailability.
The system shall provide progressive results, showing top matches quickly and then filling in additional results.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The search for recycled parts shall take no longer than 15 seconds. The search results shall be returned in under 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall support offline functionality, allowing users to view cached results and queue changes for later synchronization.
The system shall restrict the ability to change official ratings to supervisors only.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Only adjusters with a supervisor role can update preferred repair facility ratings. Users without the supervisor role cannot access the repair facility ratings.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide an audit trail for rating changes, including who made the change, when it was made, and the reason for the change.
The system shall follow corporate UI guidelines to ensure consistency with other company applications.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall comply with corporate User Interface Guidelines'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide contextual help on most main screens, including tooltips, help buttons, and a searchable help center.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a quick and simple rating mechanism, such as a star or thumbs-up, with an optional short comment.
The system shall provide immediate feedback when a rating is saved, including confirmation of successful saving or queuing for offline changes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The preferred repair facility ratings shall be saved within 5 seconds. The save shall occur within 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide audit reports within ten seconds for quick summaries and offer detailed reports later.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a summary of audit reports quickly and then load detailed reports later or email the full export.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The recycled parts audit report shall be returned to the user within 10 seconds. The audit report shall be returned within 10 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be intuitive and require minimal training, with a maximum of two days of onsite training for users to become comfortable.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be easy to learn by Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The product shall be learned with two days onsite training'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide a mechanism to open vendor contact information directly from the part result to facilitate quick communication.
The system shall provide a clear indicator for pending changes and a confirmation when changes are synced.
The system shall provide a mechanism to notify users about the status of queued changes and retry automatically when back online.
The system shall provide a mechanism to inform users about network issues and the use of cached results.
